mapper.select: SELECT R.ROOM_ID, R.ROOM_NAME, R.PRICE, R.DISCOUNT_PRICE, R.CHECK_IN, R.CHECK_OUT, R.DLT_FLAG, R.MAX_PERSON, RI.CHECK_INFO, RI.CAPACITY_INFO, RI.BEDS_INFO FROM ROOM R LEFT JOIN ROOM_INFO RI ON R.ROOM_ID = RI.ROOM_ID WHERE R.ROOM_ID=#{room_id}
mapper.update: UPDATE ROOM SET ROOM_NAME = #{room_name}, PRICE = #{price}, DISCOUNT_PRICE = #{discount_price}, CHECK_IN = #{check_in}, CHECK_OUT = #{check_out}, MAX_PERSON = #{max_person} WHERE ROOM_ID = #{room_id}
